_meta.round2_method: BREADTH sweep. The Airbnb search-results page (filter: Mellieha + Entire home/apt + min_bedrooms=3 + adults=4) DID render listing cards this round, giving a large set of Mellieha 3-bed entire-place listings each with a real total for the requested window. Shoulder (Oct 5-12): nearly all listings bookable on the EXACT window -> nightly = total/7. Peak (Aug 3-10): mostly sold out on the exact week, so the search card shows each listing's nearest bookable August window with its actual dates (e.g. 'Aug 6-10') -> nightly = total/actual-nights, dates recorded per row. Town verified via card label / listing breadcrumb; Gozo + St Paul's Bay + other towns discarded. Stephanie's own L1/L2/L3 captured directly on listing pages.
_meta.eco_tax_note: All Stephanie units charge an Eco Contribution of EUR 1.50/person/night (cash on arrival, 18+); not included in totals below. Several guest reviews note the coin-operated AC and any wifi fee are charged extra.
_meta.fee_note: Totals are the pre-tax stay totals as Airbnb displayed them in the booking panel / search card. Cleaning fees were not surfaced as separate lines for most listings; where Airbnb folds them into 'total' the nightly = total/nights is the all-in nightly the guest sees.
_meta.comp_filter: Kept = Mellieha + entire place (apartment/condo/maisonette/townhouse) + 3 bedrooms + sleeps ~6 (a few 9-guest sibling units flagged). Excluded = Gozo, St Paul's Bay/Qawra/St Julian's/Sliema/Naxxar/Zebbug/etc, room-only, <3 bed, and 28-night monthly rentals.

summary.method: Regional averages = mean of comp NIGHTLY rates (total/nights). Excludes Stephanie L1/L2/L3 and the 28-night monthly rental (C3). Shoulder comps are on the EXACT Oct 5-12 window; peak comps use each listing's nearest bookable August window (actual dates/nights recorded per row), so peak nightlies mix 4/6/7-night stays (short stays carry a premium).

stephanie.note: All three Stephanie flats sit BELOW the Mellieha 3-bed shoulder average (~EUR 184/nt), by roughly 10-12%. They are NOT the cheapest (C9 EUR 108, C11 EUR 132, C14 EUR 140 undercut them) but they price under the median (EUR 187) and well under the premium maisonettes/houses (C19/C21 EUR 240-250).

peak.caveat: Peak nightlies mix nearest-bookable windows of 4/6/7 nights; the 4-night ones (e.g. C24 EUR 365) carry a short-stay premium that inflates the mean. Excluding the EUR 469 penthouse outlier (C28) the mean is ~EUR 262/nt. Stephanie's peak is only a short-window proxy (L2 Aug 6-10 EUR 198.50/nt; L1 & L3 ~EUR 186.67/nt on 3-night windows) because her main August weeks are sold out.

stephanie.note: Stephanie's August nightlies (~EUR 187-199) sit far BELOW the Mellieha peak comp mean (~EUR 285, or ~EUR 261 ex-outlier) and below the peak median (EUR 246). Caveat: hers are short-window proxies vs comps that are mostly longer windows; still, the gap is large and consistent with her shoulder under-pricing.

summary.headline: Across a 17-comp shoulder sample and 9-comp peak sample, Stephanie's three Mellieha 3-bed flats are consistently priced BELOW the local market: ~10% under the shoulder average and ~30% under the peak average. Room to raise rates, especially in peak.
